every_position_composed.reason: Site 2 clears the text card during camera transitions in frames 4 and 7 so the 3D anchor rack is not covered like it is in Site 1's frame 4, while both sites share a minor overlap in frame 5.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D factory metaphor across frames 1 to 9 to clearly visualize raw token floods, digest compression, anchor racks, and seven host gates.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites render the identical well-crafted, grounded 3D machinery with beveled edges, metallic materials, shadows, and clean floor grids across frames 1 to 9.

type_and_layout.reason: While sharing the same crisp typography and card hierarchy, Site 2 fades the left overlay card out during camera travel in frames 4 and 7 to give the 3D scene breathing room.

overall.reason: Site 2 improves upon the same strong 3D explanatory design by hiding the text panel during scroll transitions so the 3D subject remains unobstructed as the camera moves.
